integrity: Complete induction proof and exact-arithmetic standalone checker; tests do not replace proof. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives sign and strict zero-residue positivity, not asymptotic growth or equality classifications for other residues. The sparse-base corollary assumes an odd divisor of the base plus one. Unindexed equivalent formulations are a residual priority risk.
title: A complete residue-sign law for the sparse Newman phenomenon
